quest.title: A Gift From Yae Publishing House
quest.description: At Yae Publishing House, Miko is reading the latest works hot off the press...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Fukuuchi Udon x5, Guide to Light x3

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hello there, little one. What a lovely surprise. Where have your travels taken you recently?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Miko about Minnie, the Legion of Soulblazers, and the Dragonspine Cross Country Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Aww. They all sound quite adorable.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It must have been quite an adventure for them, coming from far and wide, crossing national boundaries to meet with kindred spirits... Ah, it's a tale filled with the romance of youth.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The Soulblazer Saga seems to have quite a strong following. Maybe it's time to run another round of reprints...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: With such a dedicated fanbase, it's only right to throw a token of gratitude their way.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: How about some free comic books? Hmm... There's quite a large group of you, I'll need to make sure there's enough to go around.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: These are first-edition prints — you won't find them for sale anywhere. Take good care of them, now.

choices.text: I'll be sure to share them with the group.

talks.objective: Return to the camp and place the gift

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko gave us a pretty generous stash of comics. Since the plan is to share them with the group, why don't we display them somewhere that everyone can see?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's put them near the book stand at the Legion of Soulblazers' camp. That way, it'll be easy for people to browse.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You borrow a bookcase and arrange the comics from Miko on the shelves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice, it's looking good! Now people can come and pick some out when they're free.
